From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: New vendor setup: ClearWave banking + W-9 (Redwood PO forthcoming)

Thanks Soojin — quick notes from Finance:

- We require micro-deposit verification for new ACH payees unless there is a signed bank letter from the bank that includes the routing and account mask AND an internal risk exception. The attached bank letter may be sufficient, but we need the letter to explicitly state routing number and account type; the one Lydia attached lists the account but not the routing in the visible portion. Can the vendor supply a bank confirmation letter with routing number redacted (last 4 ok) or confirm routing in a secure form?

- If they prefer to avoid micro-deposits, Procurement can submit an exception request. Exceptions take ~3 business days to approve.

- For PO mapping: our finance system requires a vendor_id and the PO to be entered into the invoice remittance field called "Originating PO". Once vendor_id is created I will share it.

- Remittance instructions we need on invoices: PO number + invoice number + vendor_id (once provided). For now ask them to include CLEARWAVE-INV-OPS in the invoice body.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Soojin — ask ClearWave to supply either (A) scanned bank letter with routing (masked except last 4) OR (B) confirm they accept two micro-deposits and provide a contact for verification.
2) If they opt for exception, Soojin open the exception request and mark as high priority.
3) Marissa/Priyom — once we have W-9 + bank evidence, we’ll create vendor profile and return vendor_id.

Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Lydia — thanks for sending the W-9 and bank letter. Quick reply from our Finance manager below (included for context).

Ben asks for one of two options so we can proceed quickly:
- Option A: send a bank confirmation letter that includes the routing number (routing may be masked except for last 4 digits) OR
- Option B: confirm you can receive two micro-deposits and provide a named contact (email + phone) who will confirm the amounts once they post.

If you'd like to avoid the micro-deposit route, I can initiate a short exception request but Ben flagged that approvals take ~3 business days. Once we have either A or B, Finance will create your vendor profile and return a vendor_id to attach to the PO. Estimated ETA after we receive the requested bank evidence: vendor_id created within 24 business hours.

Please reply with which option you prefer and attach the bank confirmation (if Option A). Also attaching our vendor onboarding PDF in case you want to complete it now: ClearWave_Vendor_Onboard_Form.pdf.

Thanks — Soojin
